caption: The drawing depicts three rectangular wooden boards of varying widths and slightly different lengths, all attached together at the top by a short piece of cord or string passing through a pair of holes near the edge of each board. The objects are placed centrally on a plain, uncolored (ivory or off-white) background, with an artist's signature, "Geoffrey Holt," located in the lower right corner of the drawing.
